$comment: SYNTHETIC template of a project glossary for check_terminology.py (hep-authoring). Entries declare the concept, the preferred term per language (English and Traditional Chinese here), contextual aliases, the definition, abbreviations, the scope, and disallowed substitutions with the context words that make the substitution a likely confusion. Notation entries declare a symbol's definition per section scope so a legitimate local reuse is distinguishable from drift. A normalization term names its effect in contracts/vocab/effects.json (effect_id), so the word in the text and the factor in the correction chain are the same thing. Edit the values; every entry is an example.

entries.definition: the fraction of generated events whose products lie inside the instrumented geometry

disallowed.reason: efficiency is the fraction of accepted events that are reconstructed or selected; not interchangeable with acceptance
效率 (efficiency) 與 接受度 (acceptance) 不可互換

entries.definition: the fraction of accepted events that pass the selection or are reconstructed
the width of the detector response to a fixed true value

disallowed.reason: resolution is a detector property; precision describes a measurement's uncertainty
解析度 (resolution) 是偵測器性質；精度 (precision) 描述量測不確定度

entries.definition: an interval from a frequentist construction with a stated coverage

disallowed.reason: a credible interval is Bayesian; a frequentist construction gives a confidence interval
可信區間 (credible) 屬於貝氏；頻率派建構給出信賴區間 (confidence)

entries.definition: an interval of the posterior with a stated probability content

disallowed.reason: a confidence interval is frequentist; a posterior gives a credible interval

entries.definition: the uncertainty from the finite sample size

disallowed.reason: house style: 'uncertainty' for a quantified interval, 'error' for a mistake (venue-dependent; adjust)

entries.definition: acceptance times live time (for example in m^2 sr s), the factor that turns counts into a flux
the live time, in seconds, accumulated in a bin or period after the quality and transmission conditions

disallowed.reason: exposure is acceptance times live time (m^2 sr s), not a duration; a duration is the collection time or the live time
曝露量 (exposure) 是接受度乘以活時間，不是時間長度；時間長度稱為收集時間或活時間

entries.definition: what the analysts have seen of the data, kept in the exposure record of the blinding policy; not a normalization

disallowed.reason: in the blinding context say 'data exposure' (what has been seen); 'exposure' alone is the acceptance-times-live-time normalization
盲化脈絡中應稱資料曝光（已看過的資料）；曝露量是接受度乘以活時間的歸一化

entries.definition: momentum per unit charge, R = pc/(Ze), in GV

disallowed.reason: GV is the unit of rigidity (momentum per charge); for |Z| > 1 the two differ by the charge
GV 是剛度（每單位電荷的動量）的單位；|Z| > 1 時兩者差一個電荷倍數

entries.definition: the magnitude of the momentum p, in GeV/c

disallowed.reason: GeV/c is the unit of momentum; rigidity is momentum per charge, in GV
GeV/c 是動量的單位；剛度是每單位電荷的動量，單位為 GV
